about_the_game:
Oh, Bugger! is a single-player first-person shooter where you take on the role of a mech pilot on a mission to reclaim a luxury hotel overrun by an alien infestation. Set in a retro-futuristic hotel, the game combines intense combat, mech upgrades, and a visually striking environment to deliver a thrilling experience.

Key Features

  • Mech Combat: You are controlling a big mech suit with a massive mini-gun that can transform into a shotgun! With it, you mow down hordes of relentless aliens. Experience adrenaline-fueled action with satisfying gunplay and explosive effects.

  • Customization: Upgrade the abilities that your mech has. Tailor your playstyle to dominate the battlefield.

  • Retro-Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning environment inspired by retro-futuristic sci-fi designs. From the posh lobby of the hotel to the eerie glow of alien nests - every detail enhances the atmosphere.

  • Challenging Enemy Types: Face different alien threats, each one with unique behaviors. Strategize your approach to overcome every threat you face!

About the Development Team

Developed by third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences, Oh, Bugger! delivers intense action, strategic mech customization, and a uniquely stylized space environment for an unforgettable gaming experience.

content_descriptors.notes: Graphic violence such as exploding of aliens.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 @2.60 GHz or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 @3.00 GH or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 4GB VRAM or equivalen
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 @2.60 GHz or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 @3.00 GH or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 6GB VRAM or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: ‘Oh, Bugger!’ is a first-person shooter set in a luxury space hotel overrun by alien hordes. As a professional alien exterminator, pilot your mech to blast aliens and destroy their eggs, ending the infestation for good!
